lines.text: A figure in crimson-stained garments comes from Bozrah, in Moab, marching in the greatness of His strength.
He is asked why His garments are red like those of one who treads the winepress.
He says He has trodden the winepress alone, and no one from the nations was with Him.
He says the day of vengeance was in His heart, and when no one helped, His own staff brought Him salvation.
He trampled the nations in His anger and poured out their blood on the ground.
